hits.title: Brasilia | Facts, History, Map, Pronunciation & Architecture | Britannica
hits.snippet: Brasilia is the capital of Brazil . Located in the Federal District within Goias state on the central plateau of Brazil , it lies between the headwaters of the Tocantins, Parana, and Sao Francisco rivers. Because of its unique city plan and architecture, it was designated a UNESCO World Heritage site in 1987.
